Romualdez]] | [[Santiago, Agusan del Norte|Santiago]] | [[Tubay]] }} |year = 1987 |abolished = 2025 }} '''Agusan del Norte's 2nd congressional district''' was a [[congressional districts of the Philippines|congressional district]] for the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] in the province of [[Agusan del Norte]]. It was one of only two districts in the province in existence from 1987 to 2025.{{cite web |url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 25, 2021 |archive-date=March 16, 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170316064243/http://congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |url-status=dead }} The district consisted of two noncontiguous parts bordering [[Butuan Bay]] with the [[Agusan del Norte's 1st congressional district|1st district]] situated between the two. The northern portion covered the city of [[Cabadbaran]] and the municipalities of [[Jabonga]], [[Kitcharao]], [[Magallanes, Agusan del Norte|Magallanes]], [[Remedios T. Romualdez, Agusan del Norte|Remedios T. Romualdez]], [[Santiago, Agusan del Norte|Santiago]] and [[Tubay]], while the municipalities of [[Buenavista, Agusan del Norte|Buenavista]], [[Carmen, Agusan del Norte|Carmen]] and [[Nasipit]] comprised its western section.{{cite web|url=https://www.chanrobles.com/ordinance.htm |title=The 1987 Constitution of the Republic of the Philippines |publisher=Chan Robles Virtual Law Library |accessdate=February 25, 2021}} The district was dissolved in 2025 following the creation of [[Butuan's lone congressional district|Butuan's at-large congressional district]], redistricting all constituencies to the [[Agusan del Norte's at-large congressional district|province's restored at-large district]].{{Cite web |last= |date=April 4, 2022|title=Republic Act No. 11714 - An Act Reapportioning the Province of Agusan del Norte into the Lone Legislative District of the City of Butuan and the Lone Legislative District of the Province of Agusan del Norte |url=https://www.officialgazette.gov.ph/downloads/2022/04apr/20220427-RA-11714-RRD.pdf |access-date=May 11, 2022 |website=[[Official Gazette (Philippines)]]}} ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable |- ! rowspan="2" | # ! rowspan="2" colspan=2 | Image ! rowspan="2" | Member ! colspan=2 | Term of office ! rowspan="2" | Congress ! rowspan="2" | Party ! rowspan="2" | Electoral history ! rowspan="2" | Constituent
